system.description:
Starting at 20th level, you have achieved the pinnacle of illusionary skill and potential. Genjutsu you cast cannot be dispelled or Interrupted.

Additionally, Once per turn, when you cast a Genjutsu that would force a creature to make a saving throw, you can spend 3 Actualization Die. When you do, you reduce all affected creatures’ level of success by 1 stage.

(Critical Success > Success) or (Failure > Critical Failure)
